description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutablePolicy class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It tests immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, policy manipulation methods, and equality/hashCode contract.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutablePolicy class verifying immutability, JSON serialization, policy modifications, and equality contracts.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutablePolicy and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals methods for ImmutablePolicy.

methods.name: testInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that invalid policy IDs throw PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: testEmptyPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that empty policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Checks JSON serialization and deserialization preserves the policy object.

methods.name: testToAndFromJsonWithSpecialFields
methods.description: Checks JSON serialization/deserialization with special fields.

methods.name: removeEntryWorks
methods.description: Tests removal of a policy entry by label.

methods.name: setSubjectsForWorks
methods.description: Tests setting multiple subjects for a label.

methods.name: setSubjectForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Verifies setting a subject for a label copies existing data.

methods.name: setSubjectForShouldAddNewEntry
methods.description: Checks that setting a subject creates a new label entry if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: removeSubjectForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Verifies removal of a subject for a label.

methods.name: setResourcesForWorks
methods.description: Tests assigning multiple resources to a label.

methods.name: setResourceForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Verifies setting a resource copies existing resources.

methods.name: removeResourceForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Checks removal of a specific resource for a label.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsForWorks
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific subject, resource key.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsForNonExistingShouldBeEmpty
methods.description: Ensures empty result when permissions do not exist.

methods.name: newPolicyIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that a newly created policy without rules is empty.

methods.name: newPolicyWithoutID
methods.description: Verifies that a policy without explicit ID is treated as empty.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesPolicyIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that removing all entries results in an empty policy.

methods.name: modifyingTheEntrySetDoesNotModifyThePolicy
methods.description: Ensures the entries set returned is a copy, not affecting the original policy.
